body:
DynamicBounties is a lightweight, Vault-powered bounty system for Paper servers that adds competitive PvP incentives to your SMP.

Players can place money bounties on others, turning every fight into a high-stakes hunt. When a player with an active bounty is killed, the killer receives the full reward automatically.

Features:

💰 Player-placed bounties using Vault economy

⚔ Automatic payout on player kills

🏆 /bounty top leaderboard

📊 Clean GUI menu

⚙ Fully configurable (minimum bounty, broadcasts, messages)

🧠 UUID-based system (safe across name changes)

Perfect for SMP and PvP servers that want more drama, competition, and player-driven events.
